svg.text: Pantry R35 — sanitized source excerpt
Survey before cutting (printed page 4)
Text-only card: no address, parcel or permit identity and no raw source links. Quotations keep the printed wording.
printed page 4
Write measured faces on painter's tape and in the field record; do not turn the reported 111-in finished
ceiling into a stud cut.
printed page 4
READY: non-destructive measuring and removable floor tape
printed page 4
01. Mark the existing finished EX1 wall as depth zero. Tape the proposed W1 room-side finished face at
about 68 in. Mark its full 4½-in thickness and the planned 149-in finished inside run.
02. Locate the physical roof-truss bottom chord along the full W1 line; mark its center at both ends and
middle. Record any offset from the trial line. Do not infer a fastening point from the A7 PDF alone.
03. Measure W1 inside length at floor, counter height and ceiling. Record W2 column projection/width and
the actual contact plane.
04. Measure B1, B2 and B3 separately, the cabinet mounting rails, the chosen shelf-bracket holes, and
refrigerator body/door sweep. Tape a 37-in bay and 108-in base row on the floor.
05. Photograph and mark both faces of EX1 and all existing trim. Establish the closet's 37-in inside
width, 23-in depth, retained kitchen door and proposed back-wall opening boundaries.
printed page 4
If any endpoint/ceiling plane changes, revise the model, cuts, drywall sheets, trim and cart together.
Field survey itself is safe independent work; destructive exposure and drilling remain held.
Source family: r35-p04-survey.svg · printed page 4 of the R35 conditional plan (29 pages).
